fusions.name: Hydraulic Maul
fusions.desc: Swings a hydraulic maul across a cone 2.5 tiles long, which deals 13 damage to everything in it and stuns each enemy for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Trap-Spring Bite
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that closes sprung iron teeth on the target, which deals 30 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Winter Maintenance
fusions.desc: You power down and run repairs, restoring 4 health a second for 8 seconds. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Needle in the Red
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
